skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc:
Deals 5000% [Specialized Direct DMG] to targets in a cross-shaped area (affected only by advanced DMG Reduction), ignoring [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-crit DMG Reduction], and penetrates [Unyielding], [Specialized Unyielding].

Reduces the number of [Re-Battle] uses for all enemies by 3 when the skill is released. (Cannot be stacked)

skills.name: Super Ultimate
skills.desc:
Deals 7000% [Specialized Direct DMG] to targets in a cross-shaped area (affected only by advanced DMG Reduction), ignoring [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-crit DMG Reduction], and penetrates [Unyielding], [Specialized Unyielding].

Reduces the number of [Re-Battle] uses for all enemies by 4 when the skill is released. (Cannot be stacked)

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc:
At battle start, gains 80% [Specialized Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

Grants all allies permanent immunity to [Energy Reduction] and [Energy Lock] effects upon entering the battlefield.

skills.name: Awakened Passive
skills.desc: Gain 3 [4] energy points per turn. Upon entering the battlefield, grant all allies a permanent 92% [95%] [98%] [True DMG Reduction].

effects.desc: Only one of the following effects can be active at a time: resurrection or invincibility. After any character's turn, if they are defeated, they will immediately revive, recovering 100% of their health and continuing the battle (considered as 'Resurrected').
